method: UTF-8 audit of all 180 frozen proposal records; normalized lower-case title token Jaccard used as a collision alarm, followed by manual comparison of mechanism, evidence object, protected gate, and falsifier.

nearest_prior.manual_distinction: Private-source taint propagation used quarantine but not post-publication status-specific dependency updates.
The earlier mathematical proposal did not isolate compatible boundary data and continuous dependence.
The earlier sensitivity surface did not encode MNAR selection models with a zero-real-row promotion lock.
Protocol-deviation estimands differ from mediator identification under post-treatment confounding.
Participant burden parity differs from facilitator learning curves and calendar-time drift.
The earlier identity mechanism did not combine authority-cycle refusal with monotonic capability attenuation.
The earlier CBR authority mechanism did not distinguish confidentiality, compelled disclosure, and public-interest limits.
Multi-parser disagreement differs from defining the exact canonical byte payload presented for signature.
Edge-case replay did not bind rounding-environment metadata to different-architecture evidence claims.
Evidence-class non-conversion did not model resolved variables, scale ratios, or projection memory.

review_conclusion: Exactly ten genuinely distinct mechanisms are preregistered. Similar vocabulary marks shared domain context; it does not collapse the mechanism, evidence object, gate, or acceptance test into a prior proposal.
boundary: Novelty here is proposal-chain semantic distinctness, not patent novelty, scientific discovery, empirical confirmation, proof, or canon.
